Dist.-Koderma.

Opposite Parties  ----
 CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK ROSHAN

For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Shailendra Jit, Adv.
 For the State : Mrs. Anuradha Sahay, A.P.P.
 ----
 02/Dated: 03rd June, 2025 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The present application has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint Case No.167 of 2024, registered for the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the court of learned C.J.M., Koderma.
3.
Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the petitioner(s) and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that all the allegations are general and omnibus.
Further, he wants to lead conjugal live with the complainant/wife with all love and dignity.
On the above basis, prayer for anticipatory bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
